title: Laughter Is Good Medicine
topic: วิทยาศาสตร์/สุขภาพ
lines: Most people know that laughing makes them feel good, but scientists are
finding that **it** may also be good for the body. When we laugh, our
brains release chemicals called endorphins, which reduce pain and stress.
In one study, people who watched a funny video for fifteen minutes could
handle 10 percent more pain afterwards than **those** who watched a boring
Laughter also affects the heart. A good laugh increases blood flow in a
similar way to light exercise. Some hospitals now use "laughter therapy,"
in which patients join group sessions to laugh together. **They** often
report sleeping better and feeling less anxious.
Interestingly, the brain cannot easily tell the difference between real
and fake laughter. Even forcing yourself to laugh can bring some of the
same benefits. Of course, laughter cannot replace medicine. But as **one**
